title: Balancer DAO passes BIP-928 phased pool and vault sunset
description: Balancer governance approved BIP-928 on September 29, 2026. Most pausable pools are scheduled to transition to withdrawals-only October 30, with qualifying v3 partner exceptions through November 30; bug bounty coverage ends October 30. Protocol contract withdrawal paths remain available after the frontend-related changes.
notes: Approval is confirmed; implementation at October 30 and November 30 remains future as of the October 16 review.
